title: The Python Informix driver can't read a DATETIME HOUR TO SECOND
symptom: ValueError: hour must be in 0..23 reading DimTime with SELECT *
cause: informix-driver (pure Python) decodes a DATETIME that starts at HOUR as if it started at YEAR
effect: A snapshot or export of a table with a time-of-day column fails through that driver
fix: Select such columns as text (col::LVARCHAR); export.py does it from syscolumns
